name: Pullman Jakarta Central Park
short_description: A 5-star Pullman in West Jakarta with 317 rooms and suites, directly connected to Central Park Mall and over 7,000 sqm of convention space, holding a 4.6/5 ALL Rating (1,791 reviews).
ai_summary: Pullman Jakarta Central Park is a 5-star hotel in West Jakarta with 317 guestrooms and suites, directly connected to Central Park Mall and positioned between Soekarno-Hatta International Airport and Jakarta's city centre. The property has over 7,000 sqm of convention venues including one of Jakarta's largest pillarless ballrooms, several restaurants and bars, and wellness facilities, built around an 'Industrial Raw' design concept. It holds a 4.6/5 ALL Rating from 1,791 reviews on its own Accor page. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
